notes.title: BIG UPDATE for Flappy Souls!
notes.notes:
The new things: Now there are 2 difficulty modes. Now instead of collecting 3 souls, you can collect 120 swords + the golden version of each of them (it's a lot to collect). Now there are achievements, there are sound effects, quick transitions to better fluidity and other details!

So, I decided to remake the game, now it has a lot of new content! the original version was very simple and I was never very satisfied with it, I always had this desire to improve the game, and now I have done it, this remaking journey has been a lot of fun, thank you to everyone who played this game, and I hope you like this version!
